Cannabis and drug offences
It is illegal to possess, use, traffic, import or export cannabis and other controlled drugs in Malaysia, including while transiting through to other countries. Many international airports use advance screening technology and may scan the baggage of transit passengers.
Malaysia has some of the world’s strictest drug laws. Severe penalties apply, including long prison sentences of up to 20 years, caning, and the death penalty.
See more information on the Safety and security page.
